title: Two Women Standing Outside Brick House, 1947 Vintage B&W Snapshot
description: A black and white snapshot taken on June 19, 1947, featuring two women posing affectionally together in front of a brick house. The taller woman has her arm around the shoulder of the other. Both wear patterned mid-century dresses and round eyeglasses, illustrating typical post-WWII American domestic fashion and lifestyle.
